record.field: Indonesia monthly payroll: BPJS Ketenagakerjaan (JHT, Pension, Accident, Death), BPJS Kesehatan (capped), occupational-cost (biaya jabatan) and PTKP deductions, and PPh21 via the annualised progressive schedule. BPJS/PPh21 rates come from the Indonesia legislation pack. Monthly PPh21 uses the annualised method (pre-2024) — the 2024+ TER method is a v1 limitation.
